excerpt: The Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) is the Federal Reserve's main monetary policy body, holding eight regular meetings annually. Members include Board of Governors and regional bank presidents. Decisions impact national economic policy.

content.introduction: The Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) is the Federal Reserve's main monetary policy body, holding eight regular meetings annually. Members include Board of Governors and regional bank presidents. Decisions impact national economic policy.
body: The Federal Open Market Committee, or FOMC, is the Fed's chief body for monetary policy. They serve 1-year terms on a rotating basis.
